name: game-hud
title: Game HUD
description: An in-game heads-up display that mods extend with their own readouts.

world.description: Reads the state of the world around the player.

getTime.description: Returns the in-game clock as HH:MM.

getBiome.description: Returns the biome the player stands in.

getEnemyCount.description: Returns the number of nearby enemies.

isInCombat.description: Returns whether the player is in combat.

combat.description: Read combat state and draw combat readouts.

Enemy.description: A hostile creature near the player.

slots.description: A strip of readouts along the top of the screen.
The minimap frame; one mod at a time.
Combat readouts, shown while enemies are near.
